title: Empty Tithe
summary: Start: enter Empty Tithe. The log opens the job and the helm marks the Tithe Broker. Do: come within 320 meters of the Tithe Broker. The broker slides alongside and sells food at a starving price. The jurisdiction run that brings food mass is the separate route. Finish: after the broker is met, come inside Tithe Outpost's shell. Red Keel heat rises. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
